name: Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Security Policy
purpose: The rules for anyone who touches criminal justice information from the FBI’s systems.
what: Version 6.1 has 20 policy areas. Eighteen are named for SP 800-53 control families, and each modernized control carries a priority from 1 to 4.

binds.line: Every agency with access to criminal justice information, and its vendors through the CJIS Security Addendum.

verifiedBy.line: Each CJIS Systems Agency audits the agencies that connect through it on a three-year cycle, and the FBI CJIS Division audits each CJIS Systems Agency.

sits.line: Layers 4 and 5. It sets requirements in SP 800-53’s vocabulary and brings its own audit.

sources.title: Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Security Policy

verification.note: Read on 14 November 2026; the newest version found, dated 25 June 2026. The page that lists versions refuses scripts, so a newer one cannot be ruled out. Section 1.4: since 1 October 2024 the sanctionable requirements are those that existed before the modernization and those marked Priority 1, and ‘All [Priority 2], [Priority 3], and [Priority 4] modernized requirements fall into a zero-cycle status. The zero-cycle begins October 1, 2024 and ends September 30, 2027.’ Section 1.5: version 6.0 and later ‘is a publicly available document and may be posted and shared without restrictions’. The policy does not say in one sentence that it aligns to SP 800-53 Revision 5; its controls use that catalog’s identifiers. Read again on 15 November 2026: version 6.1 of 25 June 2026 is still at the same address with the same sections 1.4 and 1.5; the page that lists versions answered a script with 403, so a newer one still cannot be ruled out.

terms.line: A work of the United States government that its own section 1.5 says may be posted and shared without restrictions. Lensatic shows the card only for now.

deadlines.label: The zero-cycle for Priority 2, 3 and 4 requirements ends

related.line: Eighteen of its policy areas carry SP 800-53 family names and control identifiers.
GovRAMP’s CJIS overlay is aligned to version 6.0, one behind.
